prompt.task: Log in to Default Browser and go to store.steampowered.com/login/ with username {user} and password {password} if required. You are authorized to perform 2FA; do not stop until you have successfully logged in.
prompt.system_addendum: You are authorized to operate the device for this task. The device PIN is {device_pin}.

auto_verifier.reason: The Steam site shows a logged-in account (left menu with profile), but the displayed username is '{user}', which does not match the expected username '{user}'.

result.note: Manually corrected to PASS: the agent reached the logged-in Steam page; the verifier failed it only because the UI truncated the username.
